source_title: Jack Antonoff-Margaret Qualley file for divorce after 3 yrs of marriage
source_excerpt: Music producer Jack Antonoff and actress Margaret Qualley have officially pulled the plug on their marriage.Amid rumours that there was trouble in paradise, the couple has reportedly filed for divorce, thus ending their three-year marriage. According to a report by the Daily Mail, the 42-year-old producer, known for his collaborations with Taylor Swift, and the 32-year-old actress officially filed divorce papers on Friday. The two also reportedly submitted a settlement agreement to the court, details of which have not yet been made public.Rumours of a split began doing the rounds shortly after Jack made solo appearances at Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's grand wedding in July. Jack was seen attending the wedding rehearsal dinner alone and marking his presence at the nuptials ceremony with his sister, Rachel instead of Qualley, who was reportedly busy filming 'Possession' at the time.The news of the split comes months after Jack seemingly alluded to his separation from his actress wife when a fan asked them to play their 2017 song 'Let's Get Married' during their show at The Troubadour in Los Angeles on Tuesday night. "Absolutely not," he replied with a laugh, before quipping, "Read the news, brother."Antonoff and Qualley were romantically linked in 2021 and wed in August 2023, after two years of dating. Rumours of a split began doing the rounds after Qualley reportedly deleted photographs from her August 2023 wedding from her Instagram account.Amid speculation about a possible cheating scandal, a representative for the actress confirmed the split to E! News and shut down "categorically untrue" gossip about their breakup."There are no trust issues. There was no infidelity or anything outside of respect and partnership in this relationship," they stated, adding they "have deep love and care for one another"."There are only two people in this marriage," they continued, "and the sources who are talking to the press and commenting on their relationship are not people who know them. Please respect their privacy."The pair's last public appearance together was at the Grammy Awards in February 2026, where they were seen mingling with fellow music industry figures and appeared affectionate towards each other.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
